name: Create DNS Protection rule.
description: Create DNS Protection rule. Create a DNS Protection rule for an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/advanced_dns_protection/configs/dns_protection/rules
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/advanced_dns_protection/configs/dns_protection/rules
Create a DNS Protection rule for an account.
Required: account_id (path) — The ID of the account.; body (body) — The new DNS Protection rule to add.

name: Delete DNS Protection rule.
description: Delete DNS Protection rule. Delete a DNS Protection rule specified by the given UUID. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/advanced_dns_protection/configs/dns_protection/rules/{rule_id}

name: Delete all DNS Protection rules.
description: Delete all DNS Protection rules. Delete all DNS Protection rules for an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/advanced_dns_protection/configs/dns_protection/rules
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/advanced_dns_protection/configs/dns_protection/rules
Delete all DNS Protection rules for an account.
Required: account_id (path) — The ID of the account.

name: Get DNS Protection rule.
description: Get DNS Protection rule. Get a DNS Protection rule specified by the given UUID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/advanced_dns_protection/configs/dns_protection/rules/{rule_id}

name: List all DNS Protection rules.
description: List all DNS Protection rules. List all DNS Protection rules for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/advanced_dns_protection/configs/dns_protection/rules
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/advanced_dns_protection/configs/dns_protection/rules
List all DNS Protection rules for an account.
Required: account_id (path) — The ID of the account.
Optional: page (query) — The page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.; per_page (query) — The number of items per page. Must be between 10 and 1000. Defaults to 25.; order (query) — The field to order by. Defaults to 'prefix'.; direction (query) — The direction of ordering (ASC or DESC). Defaults to 'ASC'.

name: Update DNS Protection rule.
description: Update DNS Protection rule. Update a DNS Protection rule specified by the given UUID. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/advanced_dns_protection/configs/dns_protection/rules/{rule_id}
